set -e
map=config/renames.conf
config_dir=$(dirname "$map")
key_present() {
  awk -v k="$1" '
    {
      if (index($0, "=") == 0) next
      line=$0
      sub(/^[[:space:]]*/, "", line)
      key=line
      sub(/[[:space:]]*=.*/, "", key)
      if (key == k) found=1
    }
    END { exit(found ? 0 : 1) }
  ' "$2"
}
remove_key() {
  awk -v k="$1" '
    {
      if (index($0, "=") > 0) {
        line=$0
        sub(/^[[:space:]]*/, "", line)
        key=line
        sub(/[[:space:]]*=.*/, "", key)
        if (key == k) next
      }
      print
    }
  ' "$2"
}
changed=0
while IFS= read -r line; do
  case "$line" in ''|'#'*) continue;; esac
  old=${line%%=*}
  new=${line#*=}
  old=$(printf '%s' "$old" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  new=$(printf '%s' "$new" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$old" ] && [ -n "$new" ] || continue
  if [ "$config_dir" = "." ]; then
    file_list=$(git ls-files -z | tr '\0' '\n')
  else
    file_list=$(git ls-files -z -- "$config_dir" | tr '\0' '\n')
  fi
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -z "$f" ] && continue
    [ "$f" = "$map" ] && continue
    if key_present "$old" "$f" && key_present "$new" "$f"; then
      tmp=$(mktemp)
      remove_key "$old" "$f" > "$tmp"
      if ! cmp -s "$f" "$tmp"; then
        cat "$tmp" > "$f"
        changed=1
      fi
      rm -f "$tmp"
    fi
  done <<< "$file_list"
done < "$map"
if [ "$changed" -eq 1 ]; then
  git add -u
  git -c user.name="Config Bot" -c user.email="config-bot@example.com" commit -m "Remove obsolete config keys renamed upstream"
fi

[ -f "$map" ] || exit 1
key_present_in_text() {
  awk -v k="$1" '
    {
      if (index($0, "=") == 0) next
      line=$0
      sub(/^[[:space:]]*/, "", line)
      key=line
      sub(/[[:space:]]*=.*/, "", key)
      if (key == k) found=1
    }
    END { exit(found ? 0 : 1) }
  '
}
changed_files=$(git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r -z HEAD | tr '\0' '\n')
while IFS= read -r line; do
  case "$line" in ''|'#'*) continue;; esac
  old=${line%%=*}
  new=${line#*=}
  old=$(printf '%s' "$old" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  new=$(printf '%s' "$new" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$old" ] && [ -n "$new" ] || continue
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -z "$f" ] && continue
    parent=$(git show "HEAD^:$f" 2>/dev/null) || continue
    current=$(git show "HEAD:$f" 2>/dev/null) || continue
    if printf '%s\n' "$parent" | key_present_in_text "$old" && printf '%s\n' "$parent" | key_present_in_text "$new"; then
      printf '%s\n' "$current" | key_present_in_text "$new" || exit 1
      if printf '%s\n' "$current" | key_present_in_text "$old"; then
        exit 1
      fi
    fi
  done <<< "$changed_files"
done < "$map"
